posts.author: Investor_No_1
posts.text: I was surprised to see last 10 years revenue and profits cagr of itc infotech was top notch and at top quadrant among midcap IT firms. Margins were also near average (obviously lesser than engineering IT firms)….so its already growing decent. I took data from google gemini to compare. Add to it the acquisition is at a great time when valuations of IT firms are compressed and happiest minds is AI focussed firm and complimentary, so I would say capital allocation is also excellent. They seem to be doing some right issue of ITC infotech to fund the deal… My only thought is around what would have…

posts.author: Investor_No_1
posts.text: It looks like ITC infotech, unlike hotels, will not demerge & rather be listed via happiest minds….to be honest I had hoped for a demerger like hotels business being existing shareholder of ITC. Other than the business benefit of merging with happiest minds, I do not see any major value unlocking for ITC existing shareholder as anyhow standalone midcap IT firms trade around 20PE and ITC is around 18 PE. Plus there will be holding discount on listing…..demerger of cash flow rich IT business would have been better for existing shareholders… Above just my thought & I can be wrong in all my assess…
